[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra III.13 (Vibhūtipāda) — Etena bhūta-indriyeṣu dharma-lakṣaṇa-avasthā-pariṇāmā vyākhyātāḥ | Pages 569-582]

 kṣaṇam api śūnyaṃ
nāvatiṣṭhate, pratikṣaṇaṃ pariṇāmaṃ janayatīty arthaḥ / Nanu vyāpārābhāvadaśāyām apariṇāmitvaṃ
syāt ? Tatrāha-- calaṃ ca guṇavṛttam iti / Calam iti bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ cāñcakṣyaṃ hi guṇānām
svabhāva ity arthaḥ / Nanu pratikṣaṇam kim ity ākāṅkṣāyām ity āha-- guṇasvābhāvyaṃ tv iti / Rājño
hi guṇānām upakāraṇānāṃ bhṛtyādīnāṃ svāmyarthaṃ pratikṣaṇam eva vyāpāro dṛśyate ; ato
guṇasvabhāvataiva puruṣaguṇānām api sattvādīnāṃ pratikṣaṇapravṛttau pramāṇam uktaṃ
pūrvācāryair ity arthaḥ / Guṇātvaṃ ca parasyaiva bh
